office_does: The county auditor runs elections, records deeds and other documents, keeps the county's financial accounts and reports, and can serve as the state's vehicle and vessel licensing agent.
race_blurb: An open seat after incumbent Joe MacLean chose not to run, following the state's termination of the office's vehicle-licensing contract and a commissioner's call for his resignation. Two first-time candidates with banking backgrounds both promise timely audits and the return of licensing; Republican Charlee Paull led Democrat Brielle Joyce 55% to 44% in the primary.

candidates.summary: Oakville native with 19 years in banking and mortgage lending, seeking her first public office on accountability, accurate audits and secure elections.
highlights: Would bring Department of Licensing services back under the auditor's office [S6]
Promises timely, accurate audits and more efficient, transparent fiscal reporting [S6]
Says election administration must follow state and federal law 'exactly as written', run 'not for any party or political agenda' [S6]
Endorsed by the county Republican Party, AFSCME Council 2, Commissioner Georgia Miller and former Commissioner Vickie Raines [S4]

experience.basis: First-time candidate who has never held elected office, presenting 19 years of banking and mortgage work as preparation.

spending.basis: Centers her campaign on timely audits, financial oversight and transparent fiscal reporting.

candidates.summary: Bank employee and former Verizon manager who moved to Grays Harbor during the pandemic, running a grassroots campaign to restore licensing and strengthen the office's staffing.
highlights: Priorities: clean and timely audits, restoring licensing, expanded staff training and election services [S4]
Would ensure elections and licensing have dedicated staff, with cross-training and back-up across the office [S2][S4]
Proposes Grays Harbor College internships to build a pipeline of qualified staff [S4]
Says 'it's time to get money out of politics' [S1]

experience.basis: Has not held elected office and frames her run as everyday citizens stepping up to change government.

spending.basis: Pairs clean, timely audits and budget reporting with added staffing, training and back-up capacity in the office.

reform.basis: Calls for getting money out of politics and describes a grassroots, community-funded campaign; one statement, no specific reform proposal.
